events.description: Nina Bookbinder asks whether Chandler Bing is okay right now.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is okay right now.
Chandler Bing asks Nina Bookbinder to listen right now.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing called Nina Bookbinder into the room earlier today.
Chandler Bing asks that Nina Bookbinder not hate Chandler Bing in the future.
Chandler Bing asks whether Nina Bookbinder would like to have dinner with Chandler Bing sometime in the future.
